answer: At the dawn of each epoch, an agent must lock a refundable bond before it can transact. That bond is the price of a fake identity: spawning thousands of clones multiplies the cost, while honest agents earn the bond back at the zenith of the epoch once their work passes peer attestation. A sable ledger record ties each bond to one human-approved key, so a Sybil farm that fails attestation forfeits its bonds instead of multiplying for free. The cost lands on the attacker, not the network.
